fact: The Ministry of Finance issued a World Bank DRIVE-funded RFP for the Somalia National Single Window core platform with integrations to SOMCAS, SOMLITS and e-Cert; pre-proposal conference 8 September 2026, proposals due 30 September 2026.
title: Development of National Single Window core platform and integration with SOMCAS, SOMLITS and e-Cert
publisher: Ministry of Finance, Federal Government of Somalia (via All Business Africa)
